coca-cola-refresh-intuit.location: On the plaza, by the outdoor court
coca-cola-refresh-intuit.offer: $1 off any Coca-Cola drink with VenU

panda-express-intuit.name: Panda Express Stand
panda-express-intuit.description: Orange chicken, chow mein and rice bowls.
panda-express-intuit.location: Main Level concourse, past The Wall Entrance
panda-express-intuit.offer: Free egg roll with any bowl

coca-cola-refresh-sofi.name: Coca-Cola Refresh Stand
coca-cola-refresh-sofi.description: Cold Coca-Cola drinks, bottled water and snacks.
coca-cola-refresh-sofi.offer: $1 off any Coca-Cola drink with VenU

coca-cola-refresh-crypto.name: Coca-Cola Refresh Stand
coca-cola-refresh-crypto.description: Cold Coca-Cola drinks, bottled water and snacks.
coca-cola-refresh-crypto.offer: $1 off any Coca-Cola drink with VenU

entry-1.name: Entry 1
entry-1.description: North entrance. Clear bags up to 12×6×12 in., or a small bag up to 4.5×6.5 in. Every entry has an accessible path and free wheelchair escorts.

entry-2.name: Entry 2
entry-2.description: North entrance, open until the end at football games. Clear bags up to 12×6×12 in., or a small bag up to 4.5×6.5 in.

entry-3.name: Entry 3
entry-3.description: North entrance, open until the end at football games. Every entry has an accessible path and free wheelchair escorts.

entry-4.name: Entry 4
entry-4.description: North entrance with an accessibility podium and waiting chairs just inside. Clear bags up to 12×6×12 in., or a small bag up to 4.5×6.5 in.

entry-5.name: Entry 5
entry-5.description: North-west entrance, closest to the Green Zone (Lots A and B). Every entry has an accessible path and free wheelchair escorts.

entry-6.name: Entry 6
entry-6.description: West entrance for VIP and premium tickets, open until the end at football games.

entry-7.name: Entry 7
entry-7.description: West entrance for VIP and premium tickets, open until the end at football games. Closest to the Blue Zone (Lot N).

entry-8.name: Entry 8
entry-8.description: South entrance with an accessibility podium and waiting chairs just inside. Entry 8B stays open until the end at football games.

entry-9.name: Entry 9
entry-9.description: South entrance (gates 9A to 9D), closest to the Purple Zone (Lots K and L). Every entry has an accessible path and free wheelchair escorts.

entry-10.name: Entry 10
entry-10.description: South-east entrance with an accessibility podium and waiting chairs just inside. Entry 10B stays open until the end at football games.

entry-11.name: Entry 11
entry-11.description: East entrance for VIP and premium tickets, open until the end at football games.

entry-12.name: Entry 12
entry-12.description: North-east entrance for VIP and premium tickets, open until the end at football games.

podium-entry-4.name: Accessibility Podium 4
podium-entry-4.description: Mobility Ambassadors arrange a free wheelchair escort to your seat and back after the event. Waiting chairs. Wheelchairs can’t be lent for the event or brought to the parking lots.

podium-entry-8.name: Accessibility Podium 8
podium-entry-8.description: Mobility Ambassadors arrange a free wheelchair escort to your seat and back after the event. Waiting chairs. Wheelchairs can’t be lent for the event or brought to the parking lots.

podium-entry-10.name: Accessibility Podium 10
podium-entry-10.description: Mobility Ambassadors arrange a free wheelchair escort to your seat and back after the event. Waiting chairs. Wheelchairs can’t be lent for the event or brought to the parking lots.

rideshare-kareem.name: Rideshare Drop-off
rideshare-kareem.description: Uber, Lyft, taxis, buses and shuttles drop off on the northbound curb. Pick-up is at Kareem Court and Manchester Boulevard. By train: Metro C or K Line to LAX/Metro Transit Center, then the game-day shuttle from Bus Bay 8.
rideshare-kareem.location: Kareem Court, between Pincay Drive and Manchester Boulevard

accessible-drop-off.name: Accessible Drop-off
accessible-drop-off.description: Drop-off and pick-up for guests with disabilities. Come in from northbound Prairie Avenue via Arbor Vitae Street; leave by Touchdown Drive.
accessible-drop-off.location: District Drive, between Champions Way and Touchdown Drive

brown-zone.name: Brown Zone
brown-zone.description: Lots C and D, closest to Entries 1–5 and 12. ADA stalls (placard needed) in every lot, first come, first served. An accessible courtesy shuttle runs at select events.

green-zone.name: Green Zone
green-zone.description: Lots A and B, closest to Entries 5 and 6. ADA stalls (placard needed) in every lot, first come, first served. An accessible courtesy shuttle runs at select events.

blue-zone.name: Blue Zone
blue-zone.description: Lot N, closest to Entries 7 and 8. ADA stalls (placard needed) in every lot, first come, first served. An accessible courtesy shuttle runs at select events.

purple-zone.name: Purple Zone
purple-zone.description: Lots K and L, closest to Entry 9. ADA stalls (placard needed) in every lot, first come, first served. An accessible courtesy shuttle runs at select events.

orange-zone.name: Orange Zone
orange-zone.description: Lots E to H, closest to Entries 10, 11 and 12. ADA stalls (placard needed) in every lot, first come, first served. An accessible courtesy shuttle runs at select events.

service-animal-relief.name: Service Animal Relief Area
service-animal-relief.description: Service animals (dogs and miniature horses) are welcome; emotional support animals aren’t. Staff will show you the way to the relief area.
service-animal-relief.location: Ask Guest Experience staff for the way

guest-services-ne.name: Guest Services NE
guest-services-ne.description: Lost items, free assistive listening and headphones (ID held), free sensory kits, mobility device storage and a sensory room.
guest-services-ne.location: Level 3, northeast concourse, by the Pechanga VIP Lobby

sensory-room-ne.name: Sensory Room NE
sensory-room-ne.description: A quiet room for a break from sound, lights and crowds, in 15-minute turns, first come, first served. Ask at the Guest Services desk beside it.
sensory-room-ne.location: Level 3, inside the northeast Guest Services Center

guest-services-n.name: Guest Services N
guest-services-n.description: Lost items, free assistive listening (ID held), free sensory kits, child locator wristbands and accessible seat moves.
guest-services-n.location: Level 3, north concourse, by the Pro Shop

guest-services-se.name: Guest Services SE
guest-services-se.description: Lost items, free assistive listening (ID held), free sensory kits and directions.
guest-services-se.location: Level 3, southeast, by the SoFi VIP Lobby

guest-services-sw.name: Guest Services SW
guest-services-sw.description: Inside the Corona Beach Club. Lost items, free assistive listening and headphones (ID held), free sensory kits and a sensory room.

sensory-room-sw.name: Sensory Room SW
sensory-room-sw.description: A quiet room for a break from sound, lights and crowds, in 15-minute turns, first come, first served. Ask at the Guest Services desk beside it.
sensory-room-sw.location: Level 3, inside the southwest Guest Services Center

first-aid-ne.name: First Aid NE
first-aid-ne.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you. You can also nurse a baby here in private.

first-aid-nw.name: First Aid NW
first-aid-nw.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you. You can also nurse a baby here in private.
first-aid-nw.location: Level 3, northwest concourse; ask staff for the way

first-aid-se.name: First Aid Level 1
first-aid-se.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you. There are also first aid rooms on Levels 2, 3, 6 and 8.
first-aid-se.location: Level 1 (event level), southeast concourse; ask staff for the way

elevator-north.name: Elevator N
elevator-north.description: Guests with disabilities ride first, with up to three companions (one at peak times). Elevators and escalators reach every level.

elevator-northwest.name: Elevator NW
elevator-northwest.description: Guests with disabilities ride first, with up to three companions (one at peak times). Elevators and escalators reach every level.

pedestrian-ramp.name: Pedestrian Ramp
pedestrian-ramp.description: The stadium’s one pedestrian ramp. It reaches every level except Level 7.
pedestrian-ramp.location: Southeast side, behind the end zone

restrooms-n.name: Restrooms N
restrooms-n.description: Every restroom is accessible and has a baby changing station. Family restrooms are on every level.

restrooms-sw.name: Restrooms SW
restrooms-sw.description: Every restroom is accessible and has a baby changing station. Family restrooms are on every level.
restrooms-sw.location: Level 3, southwest concourse, near section C223

first-aid-se-6.name: First Aid SE
first-aid-se-6.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you. You can also nurse a baby here in private.

first-aid-sw-6.name: First Aid SW
first-aid-sw-6.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you. You can also nurse a baby here in private.

guest-services-ne-6.name: Guest Services Level 6 NE
guest-services-ne-6.description: Lost items, free assistive listening (ID held), free sensory kits and accessible seat moves.
guest-services-ne-6.location: Level 6, northeast, by the Pechanga VIP Lobby

guest-services-se-6.name: Guest Services Level 6 SE
guest-services-se-6.description: Lost items, free assistive listening (ID held), free sensory kits and accessible seat moves.
guest-services-se-6.location: Level 6, southeast, by the SoFi VIP Lobby

adult-changing.name: Adult Changing Station
adult-changing.description: An adult changing station, near elevator 8. Ask a Guest Experience Representative if you can’t find it.

lactation-suite.name: Lactation Suites
lactation-suite.description: Private Mamava lactation suites with seating and power, on Level 4 South, Level 6 and Level 8. Any first aid room or family restroom works too.
lactation-suite.location: Ask Guest Services for the nearest one

hydration-ne.name: Hydration Station NE
hydration-ne.description: Free filtered water. You can bring one empty, clear, non-metal reusable bottle up to 20 oz to fill here.

hydration-sw.name: Hydration Station SW
hydration-sw.description: Free filtered water. You can bring one empty, clear, non-metal reusable bottle up to 20 oz to fill here.

restrooms-nw.name: Restrooms NW
restrooms-nw.description: Every restroom is accessible and has a baby changing station. Family restrooms are on every level.

restrooms-se.name: Restrooms SE
restrooms-se.description: Every restroom is accessible and has a baby changing station. Family restrooms are on every level.

kobe-bryant-entrance.name: Kobe Bryant Entrance
kobe-bryant-entrance.description: Main entrance for all tickets. GA floor tickets enter here.
kobe-bryant-entrance.location: Chick Hearn Ct. (11th St.) at Georgia St.

star-plaza-entrance.name: Star Plaza Entrance
star-plaza-entrance.description: Main entrance for all tickets, between the Box Office and Team LA Store.
star-plaza-entrance.location: Chick Hearn Ct. (11th St.) at Figueroa St.

figueroa-entrance.name: Figueroa Entrance
figueroa-entrance.description: Main entrance for all tickets. Ask here for a free wheelchair escort.

guest-services-m12.name: Guest Services M12
guest-services-m12.description: Questions, lost items, assistive listening, sensory bags and weighted lap pads (ID needed).
guest-services-m12.location: Main Concourse, across from aisle M12

guest-services-u6.name: Guest Services U6
guest-services-u6.description: Questions, lost items, sensory bags and lap pads. Ask here for the Sensory Pod code.
guest-services-u6.location: Upper Concourse, across from aisle U6

first-aid-m3.name: First Aid M3
first-aid-m3.description: EMTs at every event, with a quiet area inside.
first-aid-m3.location: Main Concourse, across from aisle M3

first-aid-u22.name: First Aid U22
first-aid-u22.description: EMTs at every event, with a quiet area inside.
first-aid-u22.location: Upper Concourse, across from aisle U22

sensory-pod.name: Sensory Pod
sensory-pod.description: Quiet pod for one or two guests, open during every event. Guest Services has the door code.

restroom-m23.name: Restroom M23
restroom-m23.description: All-gender restroom with a changing table. Every restroom is wheelchair accessible.
restroom-m23.location: Main Concourse, across from aisle M23

restroom-u31.name: Restroom U31
restroom-u31.description: All-gender restroom with a changing table. Every restroom is wheelchair accessible.
restroom-u31.location: Upper Concourse, across from aisle U31

rideshare-chick-hearn.name: Chick Hearn Rideshare
rideshare-chick-hearn.description: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up in the white zone (eastbound).
rideshare-chick-hearn.location: Chick Hearn Ct., between L.A. Live Way and Georgia St.

rideshare-figueroa.name: Figueroa Rideshare
rideshare-figueroa.description: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up in the white zone (southbound).
rideshare-figueroa.location: Figueroa St., between 12th St. and Pico Blvd.

west-garage-lot-w.name: West Garage (Lot W)
west-garage-lot-w.description: Arena garage with designated disabled parking. Entered from Chick Hearn Ct. or Georgia St.

main-entrance.name: Main Entrance
main-entrance.description: GameFace ID lane on the left, Identity Pass lane on the right; for accessible entry, Identity Pass holders tap in at the Answers Portal. Bags up to 10×6×2 in. (medical bags up to 14×14×6). Free mobility help from security to your seat.
main-entrance.location: On the plaza, off Century Blvd. and Prairie Ave.

vip-entrance.name: VIP Entrance
vip-entrance.description: For suite, club and floor tickets (they can also use the Main Entrance).

wall-entrance.name: The Wall Entrance
wall-entrance.description: For tickets in The Wall (they can also use the Main Entrance).
wall-entrance.location: Left of the Main Entrance, past the VIP Entrance

answers-portal-main.name: Answers Portal Main
answers-portal-main.description: Guest services: lost and found, free assisted listening (photo ID held), sensory bags (ID held) and OneCourt devices.

answers-portal-terrace.name: Answers Portal Terrace
answers-portal-terrace.description: Guest services: lost and found, free assisted listening (photo ID held) and OneCourt devices.

first-aid-floor.name: First Aid Floor
first-aid-floor.location: Floor Level, under Wall 19 by the east tunnel

sensory-room.name: Sensory Room
sensory-room.description: The private Kaiser Permanente Sensory Room. Sensory bags (headphones, fidget toys) are at the Answers Portal by Main 6; ID needed.
sensory-room.location: Ask an Arena Host for the way

infant-care-room.name: Infant Care Room
infant-care-room.description: A private room for infant care. Universal restrooms are all around the arena.

mobility-hub.name: Mobility Hub
mobility-hub.description: The only rideshare drop-off and pick-up. Also taxis, family drop-off and free shuttles (ADA vans available).
mobility-hub.location: East Garage, level 1 (3700 W Century Blvd.)

east-garage.name: East Garage
east-garage.description: Standard parking; buy a pass ahead. Accessible spaces can be bought with a parking pass, first come, first served.

west-garage.name: West Garage
west-garage.description: VIP parking across Prairie Ave.; buy a pass ahead. Accessible spaces can be bought with a parking pass, first come, first served.
west-garage.location: 10117 S Prairie Ave (entrance on Prairie Ave.)

infant-care-terrace.name: Infant Care Room Terrace
infant-care-terrace.description: A private room for infant care. Every restroom also has a baby changing station.

elevators.name: Elevators
elevators.description: Elevators go from the Main Entrance to every level, and escalators link the Main and Terrace levels in the main lobby. Guests with limited mobility go first.
elevators.location: Ask an Arena Host for the nearest one

facility.noRoute: No walking route: the venue doesn’t publish this spot. Ask venue staff for the way.
facility.imHereHint: Uses this spot as your location when you ask for help
facility.noReports: No reports yet. Be the first to share what you found.

submitted.body: Thank you for submitting a facility report.

report.deleteConfirm: Delete this report? Visitors at this venue won’t see it any more.

form.subtitle: Share what you found to help the next visitor

directions.fromArrival: From {{from}}, the main way in. Somewhere else? Open that spot and tap “I’m here”.
directions.fromArrivalPlain: From {{from}}. Somewhere else? Open that spot and tap “I’m here”.
